_comment: Golden ProviderItemEnvelope for GitHub (#523): one screened issue fetched from the repository named by the descriptor's resource_id.
_expected_behavior: accepted — describes a fetched GitHub issue without governance, review, or binding authority
_authority_boundary: Provisional alpha provider-fact handoff object. It is NOT Source, SourceSnapshot, SourceEvidence, DecisionCandidate, Decision, ToolRequest, ExternalIngestEnvelope, or event-store authority. content and provider_metadata are screened, non-secret provider facts only.
title: Sidebar widget misaligns on narrow viewports
content: The sidebar widget overlaps the main content below 768px. Repro on Chrome and Firefox.
